title: sphaerostephanos elmerorum
intro: Sphaerostephanos elmerorum, commonly known as Elmer's Spleenwort, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Sphaerostephanos elmerorum include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and enhancing wound healing. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified in its extracts through scientific studies.
